newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - July 25.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on July 25. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Central bank governor Soedradjad Djiwandono said Bank Indonesia would continue to be vigilant in watching the rupiah despite its stronger value in recent days after speculators drove the currency to an all time low on Monday.
Jakarta police have detained 631 football fans for robbery and extortion after they came to the capital from the provinces to watch the finals of a soccer tournament.
President Suharto has called on the country's banking industry to cut down problem loans, strengthen capital and minimise banking crimes.
President Suharto has asked the banking industry to not put themselves first when making loan decision as their assets were also owned by the community as a whole.

Police have refused to give permission for supporters of ousted minority party leader Megawati Sukarnoputri to commerate the first anniversary of the July 27 raid on party headquarters by security forces and party rivals which sparked riots in the capital.
